Company Description Taxblock India is a tech-first FinTech company that develops digital solutions for Income Tax, GST, US Tax, and personal finance for individuals, SMEs, and large enterprises. The organization also supports clients with investment management, new business setup, ROC compliances, business taxation, digital signature certificates, and legal document preparation. Taxblock combines technology-driven platforms with deep domain expertise to simplify complex financial and compliance processes. The company is led by co-founders with Ivy League MBA and Chartered Accountant backgrounds, bringing strong professional experience in financial services. Team members join a growing, innovation-focused environment with opportunities to contribute to impactful financial products and services.
Role Description The GST Advisor role at Taxblock is a full-time, on-site position based in Pune City. The GST Advisor will provide end-to-end GST advisory and compliance support, including registration, return filing, reconciliation, and responding to client queries. The role involves reviewing GST laws and notifications, interpreting their impact on clients, and preparing opinions and documentation for audits, assessments, and notices. The GST Advisor will collaborate with internal teams to ensure accurate data collection and timely filings, while maintaining high standards of accuracy and regulatory adherence. Daily responsibilities also include client communication, issue resolution, and contributing to process improvements and knowledge repositories related to GST.
Qualifications

• Strong knowledge of GST laws, rules, and regulations, including compliance procedures, return filing, and reconciliation.
• Ability to analyze financial data and transaction records for GST implications, including input tax credit and tax liability computations.
• Experience in drafting GST-related documentation such as responses to notices, audit support papers, and advisory notes.
• Proficiency in using tax and accounting software, Excel, and digital tools for data management and reporting.
• Effective communication and client-handling skills, with the ability to explain complex GST concepts clearly and professionally.
• Strong attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and capacity to work systematically under deadlines.
• Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CA, CMA, or relevant tax certifications are an advantage.
• Prior experience in GST advisory, indirect taxation, or related compliance roles in a CA firm, consulting firm, or corporate tax department is preferred.

Mutual Fund /hedge funds in Capital Market Domain 

Are you curious, motivated, and forward-thinking? At FIS, you will have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in financial services and technology. About the team 

We are looking for an individual to join the Client Experience (Product Support) team supporting Investment Accounting Manager (formerly InvestOne). The team provides production support to global IAM clients across a suite of products, with InvestOne at the core. 

What you will be doing 

Principal responsibilities 

• Provide day-to-day support to clients across multiple FIS products. 

• Ensure client queries are resolved with high-quality, timely responses. 

• Act as the first escalation point for clients and liaise with Level 3 support teams to ensure issues are prioritized and resolved. 

• Work closely with internal teams, including Product Development, Technology Services Management, Professional Services, and other relevant groups. 

• Understand client configurations and workflow processes, recreate client scenarios, and report issues to the appropriate teams. 

• Document customer information and recurring technical issues to support product-quality programs and product development. 

• Recreate client issues in test environments and identify and document how applications and systems interact to support business processes. 

• Contribute to ad hoc projects and initiatives based on business needs. 

• Maintain client satisfaction through regular follow-ups, feedback gathering, expectation management, and clear, efficient communication. 

• Work in rotational APAC shifts. 

What you bring 

Knowledge and experience 

• Minimum 7-9 years of Capital Markets experience, with a focus on fund accounting. 

• NAV calculation experience with mutual funds or hedge funds. 

• Essential knowledge of financial instruments and fund accounting. 

• Excellent oral and written communication skills. 

• Experience working with InvestOne is an added advantage. 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. 

Qualifications 

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 

Competencies 

• Fluent in English. 

• Self-starter with a team-oriented mindset and the ability to work as part of a global team. 

• Strong customer-service and team focus. 

• Ability to work effectively with minimal supervision and demonstrate a strong sense of ownership. 

What we offer you 

• A modern, international work environment with a dedicated and motivated team. 

• A variety of career-development tools, resources, and opportunities. 

• Time to support charities and give back to your community. 

• A broad range of benefits designed to support your lifestyle and wellbeing. 

• Great workspaces with dedicated and motivated colleagues. 

• A broad range of professional education and personal-development opportunities. 

• A work environment built on collaboration, flexibility, and respect. 

Privacy Statement 

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice. 

Sourcing Model 

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

With a global footprint spanning more than 80 countries and including over 75% of the Fortune 100, Perforce Software, Inc. is trusted by the world’s leading brands to deliver solutions for the toughest challenges. The best run DevOps teams in the world choose Perforce. 

About the role

Perforce Software is looking to build a finance production team in India to run recurring finance work: commissions, expense reporting, and central finance reporting. The Center Leader is the first hire and would be the on-site owner of that team. There may be an opportunity to scale a team, set up how it works, and lead global processes in a controlled, well-documented way.

• 10+ years of finance or finance operations experience, including 4+ years leading a team.

• Experience setting up and/or running a shared services, finance operations or global capability center team.

• Strong grounding in accounting and financial reporting; US GAAP familiarity.

• Experience with ERP, planning and reporting tools (NetSuite, Adaptive Planning or similar) and advanced Excel.

• Track record of documenting processes and cross-training work between teams or locations.

• Excellent written and spoken English, and comfort working with US-based leaders.

• Degree in finance, accounting or a related field; CA, CMA, CPA or MBA preferred.

• AI fluency - Level 2: Skilled Prompter (Advanced Foundation / Early Proficient).

• Experience in software or SaaS finance.

• Experience with commissions, sales compensation or revenue-related reporting.

• Experience with Adaptive Planning, Power BI, Salesforce or CaptivateIQ.

All employees are expected to demonstrate AI fluency appropriate to their role and level, including responsible use of AI tools, sound judgment, and adherence to company AI governance and security policy standards.

ABOUT FRIDO

Frido is a fast-growing Indian consumer brand focused on improving everyday comfort, mobility and quality of life through innovative, thoughtfully designed products.

Our portfolio spans cushions and pillows, ergonomic furniture, footwear, orthotics and mobility products. We operate across D2C, marketplaces, quick commerce, offline retail and B2B channels, with growing in-house manufacturing capabilities.

As we continue to scale, we're strengthening our finance team to support better business decisions, operational efficiency and sustainable growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly analytical, hands-on FP&A professional who can independently drive financial planning, business performance analysis and management reporting.

The role involves working closely with the founders, finance leadership and functional heads to provide reliable financial insights, identify improvement opportunities and support key strategic decisions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Financial Planning & Analysis

- Own annual budgeting, rolling forecasts and long-term financial planning.

- Develop and maintain detailed financial models across business channels and product categories.

- Track actual performance against budgets and forecasts, identify deviations and recommend corrective actions.

- Drive revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, EBITDA and cash flow projections.

2. Business Finance & Profitability

- Analyse channel-wise, category-wise and SKU-level profitability.

- Deep dive into D2C and marketplace unit economics, including marketing expenditure, logistics, discounts, returns and contribution margins.

- Partner with marketing, marketplaces, sales, manufacturing and supply chain teams to identify opportunities for revenue growth and cost optimisation.

- Evaluate the financial viability of new products, categories, channels and business initiatives.

3. MIS & Leadership Reporting

- Own preparation of monthly MIS, performance dashboards and business review presentations.

- Develop clear and actionable insights for founders and senior management.

- Ensure consistency and accuracy of financial and operational KPIs across departments.

- Improve reporting processes through automation and better data integration.

4. Investor Reporting & Strategic Finance

- Support preparation of board presentations, investor updates and financial performance reports.

- Coordinate financial information and analyses required for fundraising and due diligence.

- Build financial scenarios and sensitivity analyses to support strategic decision-making.

- Work closely with external advisors and internal stakeholders on financial information requirements.

5. Cash Flow & Working Capital

- Prepare and maintain cash flow forecasts and monitor funding requirements.

- Analyse inventory, receivables, payables and working capital efficiency.

- Support capital expenditure planning and investment evaluations.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- CA / MBA Finance / CFA or equivalent qualification.

- 5–10 years of relevant experience in FP&A, business finance or corporate finance.

- Prior experience in D2C, e-commerce, FMCG, retail or high-growth consumer businesses preferred.

- Strong financial modelling skills and advanced proficiency in Excel.

- Experience with Power BI, SQL or other analytical tools would be an advantage.

- Strong understanding of P&L, cash flow, unit economics and operational KPIs.

- Experience in management presentations, investor reporting or fundraising support preferred.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- High ownership: Someone who can independently drive deliverables from start to finish.

- Strong analytical mindset: Ability to go beyond reporting numbers and understand the underlying business drivers.

- Business orientation: Comfortable working closely with functional leaders and challenging assumptions.

- Speed and accuracy: Ability to manage multiple priorities without compromising quality.

- Effective communication: Can simplify complex financial analysis and communicate insights clearly.

- Hands-on approach: Equally comfortable building detailed Excel models and presenting findings to senior leadership.

WHY JOIN FRIDO?

- Opportunity to work directly with the founders and senior leadership.

- Meaningful involvement in strategic and operational business decisions.

- Exposure to a fast-scaling omnichannel consumer business with manufacturing operations.

- Opportunity to build scalable financial planning and reporting processes.

- High ownership, learning and career growth.

data.job_title: Chief Accounting Officer – Financial Control – Financial Services Apolis Consulting
data.job_description:
Position Summary:

The Financial Control team consists of approximately 70 employees, based primarily out of London and Pune, responsible for the preparation and review of all internal and external financial and regulatory information for the Company PLC Group.

The Chief Accounting Officer, India is a member of the Group Financial Control team, reporting to the Head of Finance Operations in London. The Group Financial Control team are responsible for the internal and external financial and regulatory reporting prepared for the Board, Shareholders and regulators of the Company Group. This includes, but is not limited to, the quarterly financial statements, monthly management reports and regulatory returns. In addition, the team supports management and the wider business in assessing the impact of accounting and business developments.

The Chief Accounting Officer, India is a senior leadership role within Group Financial Control, reporting to the Head of Finance Operations. The role is responsible for building and scaling the Company’s finance capability in Pune, leading financial control, statutory and regulatory reporting, and supporting the delivery of accurate, timely financial information to management, the Board, shareholders and regulators. The position will partner closely with global finance leaders to drive operational excellence, strengthen the control environment, lead strategic finance transformation initiatives, and develop a scalable finance infrastructure to support the Company’s continued growth. The role will actively support the Group Financial Controller in building and ensuring the Financial Control function operates to the highest level of quality, delivering timely and accurate financials and management information to its key internal and external stakeholders.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Lead the Company’s ongoing development of India’s group finance team in Pune starting with legal entity control function and further expanding to all aspects of Finance functions which includes Supplier solutions, FP&A, Revenue and Cost control, Balance sheet Investments and substantiation, regulatory returns and financial reporting.

• Work closely with the Company Head of Finance & Finance director and other peers in London on all areas covering leading and developing finance team in Pune.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to CFOs, head of finance, controllers.

• Drive transformation initiatives from India and best practices adoption.

• Demonstrated ability to build capabilities, scale teams and drive operational excellence.

• Manage all aspects of the yearly subsidiary audits and all related disclosures, delivering timely and accurate statutory reporting and be the key face off to the external auditors.

• Contribute to the monthly Group financial control close process, overseeing all relevant assigned aspects of data preparation for ingestion into the ERP, and following through to reviewing the relevant accounting output from the ERP, ensuring all facets align with expectations, and conducting other requisite analytical reviews and substantiation checks.

• Deliver timely and accurate monthly cost reporting, including generating key insights and explains to cost drivers with respect to variances of actuals to prior periods and the budget.

• Review and oversee regulatory reporting for the Company regulated entities, typically encompassing accounting, capital, liquidity, and assets under management data.

• Ensure a robust control environment underpins the reporting deliverables. Contribute to the teams development of enhanced control frameworks.

• Evaluate existing processes and booking model changes.

• Work with our internal Tax team to manage the tax elements of our financials.

• Mentor and develop AD/Senior managers, managers and manage and support the growth of other team members.

• Lead and deliver on several key finance and wider the Company Group projects.

• Develop a knowledge through time of the various key Investments/Assets held on the PLC’s balance sheet, across the various strategies of Corporate Investments, Capital Markets, Real Assets (Real Estate and Infrastructure Equity), and Private Equity Secondaries.

• Develop knowledge and implement key accounting changes and pronouncements such as IFRS 18.

Key Requirements/ Qualifications:

• 10+ years PQE in either/and: Financial Reporting, Financial Regulatory Reporting or Financial Control.

• Qualified Accountant – ACA or equivalent.

• Past Organisations: Publicly listed organisations, Asset Managers, PE & Venture Capital, Other Financial Services and / or Tier I Consulting/Professional Services firms.

• IFRS GAAP experience and background in producing IFRS compliant Annual Financial Statements.

• Familiarity with risk and control self-assessment frameworks such as RCSA’s and SOX compliance.

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

So, what’s the role all about?

The Senior Business Finance Analyst is responsible for business performance analysis, reporting, and forecasting. Work with team on recognition and backlog reviews, and provides financial modeling, budgeting, and ad hoc analysis that feed long-term strategic planning and resource allocation.

How will you make an impact?

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline preferred.
• Minimum 5 years of relevant FP&A / business finance experience, ideally with exposure to revenue forecasting, tracking, or recognition.
• Strong Excel/Analytical skills (financial modeling, pivot tables, advanced formulas).
• Ability to work under pressure on multiple projects and deadlines.
• Ability to effectively prioritize workload and manage changes in the direction of the company.
• Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to work cooperatively and collaboratively with all levels of employees and management to maximize performance.
• Ability to act and operate independently with minimal daily direction.
• Confidence to liaise and present to Senior Management.
• Desire to work in a matrixed environment.
• Accuracy and attention to detail.

Have you got what it takes?

• Intermediate skill level in MS Office applications.
• Experience with Power BI and Oracle.
• Familiarity with revenue recognition concepts (e.g. deferred revenue, backlog vs. recognized) in a subscription or services-based business.
• Prior technology industry experience.
• Revenue forecasting & tracking — own the revenue forecast / recognition and weekly close process. Track sales pipeline, bookings, revenue and renewals.
• Reporting & analysis — create meaningful ad-hoc and standard reports and refine existing ones. Each month, analyze actuals against forecast/budget and communicate weekly metrics, monthly results, and variance analysis, as well as quarterly and annual projections.
• Business partnering — act as a point of contact for the Revenue team and other stakeholders on financial modeling, budgeting, and business planning questions.
• Special projects — stay agile as new projects, initiatives, and opportunities arise — special projects are an opportunity to grow beyond the traditional analyst scope.
• Modeling — build models, from simple to sophisticated, from scratch, and improve existing ones. Creativity and new ideas are welcome.
• Data analysis — help the business understand, analyze, and draw conclusions from data to support decision-making.

What’s in it for you?

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

Role Overview:

The Equity Market Risk Management team is a core function within Market Risk Management, responsible for the independent oversight and challenge of trading activities and for ensuring that associated risks are appropriately identified, measured, monitored, controlled, and reported. The team supports key market risk frameworks including Value-at-Risk (VaR), Stressed VaR (SVaR), FRTB, stress testing, sensitivities, backtesting, and regulatory risk reporting, working closely with Trading, Market Risk, Quantitative Analytics, Product Control, and Risk Technology teams.

The role is primarily an Equity Risk Manager position, with responsibility for daily desk coverage, independent risk assessment, limit monitoring, challenge of trading activity, and escalation of material risks. The successful candidate will assess changes in exposures and portfolio risk, identify concentrations and emerging risk themes, engage directly with Front Office and senior risk stakeholders, and support risk appetite, governance, and regulatory processes. The role also contributes to new product approvals, model and methodology enhancements, and market risk infrastructure change, providing broad exposure to cash equities, derivatives, volatility products, and equity financing.

Key Responsibilities:

Equity Market Risk Management

• Provide daily risk management coverage for assigned Equity trading desks, reviewing market risk reports and identifying material changes in exposures, limit utilisation, exceptions, and unusual portfolio movements.
• Analyse and explain movements in VaR, SVaR, FRTB measures, stress losses, sensitivities, volatility and correlation exposures, and other relevant market risk metrics.
• Independently challenge significant changes in risk exposures and trading activity, engage with Front Office to understand key drivers, and escalate material concerns to senior Market Risk stakeholders.
• Monitor portfolio concentrations across single names, sectors, indices, regions, strategies, maturities, volatility surfaces, and basis risks, and assess whether exposures remain within approved risk appetite.
• Perform VaR and FRTB-related analysis, including backtesting reviews, exception investigations, modellability, and risk-factor coverage assessments.
• Assess the impact of market events, earnings announcements, corporate actions, volatility shifts, correlation changes, concentration risks, and stressed market conditions on portfolio risk profiles.
• Support new products, trading strategy, and business initiative approvals by assessing risk characteristics and ensuring appropriate limits, measurement, reporting, controls, and governance are established.
• Work closely with Market Risk Managers, Front Office, Quantitative Analytics, Product Control, and Risk Technology teams to resolve risk issues and support methodology or product enhancements.
• Support regulatory initiatives and strategic programs relating to FRTB, model governance, risk capital, and market risk infrastructure improvements.
• Define and execute test scenarios, perform UAT, validate results, and coordinate issue resolution for risk system enhancements and change initiatives.
• Identify weaknesses in risk data, controls, calculations, or reporting processes and drive remediation with relevant stakeholders.
• Prepare risk analysis and management information for senior risk stakeholders, governance forums, limit reviews, and regulatory reviews.
• Contribute to automation and analytical initiatives that enhance risk reporting, transparency, and operational effectiveness.

Qualifications
• 7+ years of experience within Equity Market Risk, Equity Derivatives Risk, Market Risk Analytics, Product Control, Quantitative Risk, or a related traded-risk management function.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 university in Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Quantitative Finance, or a related quantitative discipline.
• Strong understanding of market risk methodologies including VaR, SVaR, stress testing, Greeks and sensitivities, volatility and correlation risk, backtesting, FRTB, and regulatory market risk frameworks.
• Strong product knowledge across cash equities, equity options, futures, swaps, listed and OTC derivatives, structured products, volatility products, and equity financing.
• Experience providing trading desk risk coverage, independently challenging risk movements and trading activity, monitoring limits and concentrations, escalating material issues, and interpreting risk metrics to support risk management decisions.
• Demonstrated ability to collaborate across Market Risk, Front Office, Quantitative Analytics, Technology, and Change teams.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to communicate complex risk concepts effectively

Technical Skills (All Levels)
• Advanced Excel; SQL and Python required.
• Familiarity with risk systems, data platforms, and control frameworks.
• CFA / FRM / CQF is an advantage.
